# rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager (Resource)

The `rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager` resource is used to register an AWS KMS key
manager in RSC.

A key manager is a stored connection profile giving RSC access to a customer
owned key management service. RSC takes the credentials from the cloud account,
so no credentials are stored. Its ID is the value archival locations refer to
the key manager by, alongside the ID of the key itself, which comes from AWS.

-> **Note:** The AWS account must be onboarded to RSC with the
   `CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT` feature, and the feature must be connected.

-> **Note:** RSC only supports updating the `name`, the `description` and the
   region endpoints. Changing any other argument replaces the key manager. RSC
   refuses to delete a key manager which still encrypts an archival location.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register an AWS KMS key manager for an AWS account onboarded with the
# CLOUD_NATIVE_UEM_KEY_MANAGEMENT feature.
resource "rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager" "production" {
  name             = "Production AWS KMS"
  description      = "KMS keys for the RCV archival locations."
  cloud_account_id = "f8c9c2a0-f02e-494d-bba9-0d4906917b8c"
  region           = "us-east-2"
}

# The key manager ID is the value an RCV archival location refers to it by.
resource "rubrik_aws_rcv_archival_location" "archive" {
  name   = "us-east-2-kms-archive"
  region = "us-east-2"
  tier   = "BACKUP"

  kms_key {
    key_manager_id = rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager.production.id
    key_id         = "9c3f1b3e-9f2a-4c05-9d3f-1f2d0a5b8e77"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID of the AWS account holding the KMS keys. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `name` (String) Key manager name. Key manager names are unique across all key managers.
- `region` (String) AWS region of the KMS keys, e.g. `us-east-2`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Key manager description.
- `kms_region_endpoint` (String) AWS KMS regional endpoint RSC uses to reach the key management service.
- `sts_region_endpoint` (String) AWS STS regional endpoint RSC uses to assume the role of the cloud account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RSC key manager ID (UUID).
